title: give the gate a separate place to report an intended base-overlay revert failure, so it is not counted on the Tests line

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-183721-0a4e, project ork, item S527:

give the gate a separate place to report an intended base-overlay revert failure, so it is not counted on the Tests line

Evidence: round-1 report refused with "PASS reports failed tests" because the Tests line counted the overlay-1.json revert run, which fails by design
